svg.aria-label: songKHEM. Accessibility app that reads Khmer documents aloud for blind and low-vision users. Scan with the camera, an image or a multi-page PDF; On-device OCR, or Google Cloud Vision for accuracy; Azure neural voices with word-by-word highlighting; Web app plus an Expo mobile app; Serverless proxies keep API keys out of the browser. Built with Vue, Expo, Google Cloud, Azure TTS.
